args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 release
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate was 0.18 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, in all production regions. The rollback reports VERIFIED and all three regions now run v2.3.0. v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1 are marked unhealthy and were not redeployed. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health checks have recovered, and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release marked healthy. v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both unhealthy, and checkout-api was at v2.3.1 with an error rate of 0.18 before the rollback.
- **Approval:** Not needed, because v2.3.0 has already been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

I did not re-check the service status after the rollback, so recovery is unconfirmed. Someone should verify that health checks and the error rate have returned to normal, and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before it is released again.
